data.name: Arron
data.gender_notes: Arron is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Arron means 'little lion'. This strong and courageous name is derived from the Greek word 'arrhos', meaning 'manly' or 'courageous'. In the Bible, there is no character named Arron, but the name has a spiritual connection to the lion of Judah and the courageousness of Christ. The name Arron carries the meaning “Little lion” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Arron usually hope their child will grow to embody little lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the strength and courage of God.
data.etymology: Arron belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little lion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arron total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_greek.name: Αρρών
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name אהרון (Aharon), meaning 'mountain of strength' or 'exalted mountain'. In Greek mythology, Arron was an epithet of the god Helios, representing the golden mountain of the sun.

in_latin.name: Aaron
in_latin.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name אהרון (Aharon), meaning 'mountain of strength' or 'exalted mountain'. In Latin, Aaron is simply the Romanized form of the Hebrew name.

in_english.name: Arron
in_english.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name אהרון (Aharon), meaning 'mountain of strength' or 'exalted mountain'.

data.cultural_impact: Arron is a name that embodies strength, courage, and the fierce spirit of a lion. It is a powerful name that carries a sense of nobility and valor. It can be a bold choice for parents looking for a name that speaks of courage and character. Arron's Greek origins also add an international flair and connection to the rich history of the ancient world.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of Arron lies in its connection to the Bible and the symbolism of the lion in Christian tradition. Even though there is no character named Arron in the Bible, the name carries a deep spiritual meaning. The lion is a powerful symbol in scripture, representing Christ in several passages. In Revelation 5:5, we read, "Then one of the elders said to me, 'Do not weep! See, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed. He is able to open the scroll and its seven seals.'"
